name: Mustard oil
description: Pungent yellow oil, smoked till it stops biting — the North Indian and Bengali frying fat.

tcm.note: The mustard family is hot and dispersing in the Chinese reading.

ayurveda.note: Sarshapa taila is ushna and tikshna — the classic winter massage and cooking oil, kapha- and vata-reducing.

unani.note: Garam-khushk; rubbed on for cold, stiffness and chest congestion.

histamine.note: Pure fat, so effectively nothing — the pungency is not a histamine mechanism.
